purpose: Downloadable background examples. The four seasonal PNGs also supply the indexed built-in presets.
conversion: Pillow ImageOps.fit to 240x320 RGB PNG using LANCZOS, no artwork retouching. Upload page performs its own 96x128 / 16-color conversion.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE standalone wallpaper for a tiny 240x320 portrait companion screen. Output exactly 768x1024 or another exact portrait 3:4 size. Background artwork only, no characters, no faces, no animals in foreground, no letters, text, UI, borders, logos or watermarks. Large simple flat or gently cel-shaded color shapes, restrained palette of at most 12 dominant colors, no grain, no tiny texture, no fine repetitive lines, no photorealism. It must remain attractive after downsampling to 96x128 and 16 colors. Keep central 65% of width, from 15% to 85% height quiet and low contrast for an expressive face or a large blue-haired whale maid portrait overlay. Top 12% and bottom 18% also calm for translucent UI panels. Environmental accents are sparse and confined mainly to side edges; no central focal subject. Deliver only the image. Theme: A perfectly uniform solid pale mint green #DDF3E8 edge to edge. Absolutely no gradients, objects, shading, decorative marks, texture or vignette. A clean calm pastel canvas for dark mint-face expressions.
